fundamentals.long_business_summary: Silicon Valley Acquisition Corp. does not have significant operations. The company focuses on effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization, or other similar business combination with one or more businesses. It intends to target companies in the fintech and digital assets, AI and digital infrastructure, energy transition and sustainability, mobility and autotech, technology, consumer, mining, and healthcare industries. Silicon Valley Acquisition Corp. was incorporated in 2025 and is based in Palo Alto, California.
